mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; perphenazine may inhibit metabolism of amitriptyline via CYP2D6, increasing tricyclic levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity, sedation, and cardiac arrhythmias; consider dose reduction of amitriptyline or use alternative antipsychotic with lower CYP2D6 inhibition.
